parameters.name: k0
parameters.note: Coefficient k of the family; the surface is continuous in it, so dragging it walks the family through its transitions

parameters.name: k1
parameters.note: Coefficient k' of the family; the surface is continuous in it, so dragging it walks the family through its transitions

parameters.name: k2
parameters.note: Coefficient k'' of the family; the surface is continuous in it, so dragging it walks the family through its transitions

parameters.name: size
parameters.note: The length a the coefficients are measured against. It rescales the surface inside the clip ball rather than the finished object, so it changes how much is shown

provenance.definition: Closed form reproduced numerically against the shipped implementation (math_art/surfaces/algebraic.py) over 240 sample points: matches oracle x 1 over 240 points (worst 0).
sources: E. Goursat, 'Etude des surfaces qui admettent tous les plans de symetrie d'un polyedre regulier', Ann. Sci. ENS 3e serie 4 (1887).
